g.text: The Communion antiphon read at the Epistle-side Missal
priest: standing · predella-epistle-corner · faces missal · eyes missal · joined-before-breast
AC1: kneeling · step-1-epistle · faces altar · eyes altar · joined-before-breast
AC2: kneeling · step-1-gospel · faces altar · eyes altar · joined-before-breast
UNRESOLVED: The moment at which the corporal is folded into the burse after the vessels are
cleansed is not fixed by the approved record.
UNRESOLVED: The moment at which the chalice is covered and veiled after the ablutions is not
fixed by the approved record, which settles only that the priest descends with the veiled
invariants: INV-FORM-01, INV-GEO-01, INV-GEO-02, INV-GEO-03, INV-MISSAL-01, INV-ROLE-01,
The centre transition and the Postcommunion prayers
“Dominus vobiscum - Oremus - the Postcommunion prayer or prayers” (audible)
priest: standing · predella-epistle-corner · faces missal · eyes missal · extended
AC1: kneeling · step-1-epistle · faces altar · eyes altar · joined-before-breast
AC2: kneeling · step-1-gospel · faces altar · eyes altar · joined-before-breast
VARIANT [seasonal] On a Lenten ferial day from Ash Wednesday through Wednesday of Holy Week the
Postcommunion is followed by 'Oremus - Humiliate capita vestra Deo - Oratio super populum'.
UNRESOLVED: The depth of the priest's bow to the cross at each 'Oremus' is not fixed by the
invariants: INV-FORM-01, INV-GEO-01, INV-GEO-02, INV-GEO-03, INV-MISSAL-01, INV-ROLE-01,
